thread:
ivan-kovacev: Hey payroll team, noticed my March paycheck shows both UK PAYE and Dutch loonheffing taken out for the same pay period. Net pay is much lower than expected. Can someone help? :confused:
maria-payroll: Hi @ivan-kovacev — sorry about that. Can you DM me a screenshot of the paystub (redact bank acct)? Also can you confirm your official work location/date of move?
ivan-kovacev: Sent the screenshot and my move date — relocated to Amsterdam on 2024-03-10 (secondment).
lisa-hr: tagging in — Ivan was on a 6-month secondment from the UK team. We submitted the secondment form but I think the A1 certificate process might still be pending.
maria-payroll: Thanks. Looks like GlobalPay processed payroll using both resident tax flags because there was a UK payroll residency still active for March run. The paystub lines: 
```
Gross: 4,200.00 EUR
UK PAYE: -580.00 GBP
Dutch loonheffing: -980.00 EUR
Net: 2,xxx.xx
```
That double social security / tax is why net is off.
jamie-peopleops: @maria-payroll any immediate fix? Ivan needs living expenses covered this month.
maria-payroll: Opening a reclaim/adjustment ticket with GlobalPay now. We can do a retroactive correction on April payrun: reverse the UK withhold, apply A1 exemption going forward, and process a net top-up to cover the shortfall if necessary. Need HR to confirm A1 or certificate of coverage ASAP.
payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-4827 — "Retro payroll correction: double-tax on ivan-kovacev Mar 2024". ETA: initial response from provider in 48 hours.
lisa-hr: I found the A1 request in our queue; it was submitted but awaiting confirmation from UK HMRC. I will follow up today and move it to expedited.
maria-payroll: Once provider confirms we will: 1) reverse duplicate UK PAYE deductions for March, 2) post a correcting line on the April paystub showing the gross/net adjustments, 3) coordinate reclaim of employer NI if any. Note that reclaim timelines for social security can vary — could take several weeks.
ivan-kovacev: Appreciate it. Will this affect year-end statements (UK P60 / NL jaaropgaaf)?
maria-payroll: Good question — yes, corrections will be reflected on relevant year-end statements. UK side: if PAYE was reported, HMRC will need the correction and you may receive an updated P60 or a manual adjustment. Netherlands: jaaropgaaf will include the corrected taxable amounts. We'll document everything for tax advisors.
jamie-peopleops: Also flagging payroll to enable a temporary hardship payment switch if the reclaim extends past payroll cycle. @maria-payroll can you confirm by EOD whether a one-time net top-up is possible?
maria-payroll: Confirmed — we can do a one-time net gross-up/top-up on next payroll if necessary. Will update PR-4827 once GlobalPay responds.
ivan-kovacev: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
lisa-hr: I'll ping HMRC and the secondee coordinator. Expect an update here by EOD.
payroll-bot: PR-4827 updated: provider acknowledged, awaiting docs.
maria-payroll: Closing loop: planned actions documented in ticket; we'll keep you posted and attach the corrected paystub when done.
